headline: Drive-only overlay + controller mapping
notes: [[title:What's new]] [[new]] Drive-only overlay. Show the overlay only while you're actually driving. It hides in menus, the garage, and pauses. [[img:asset:wn_146_driveonly.png]] [[new]] Start with Windows. New toggle in Preferences to launch Segue on boot. [[img:asset:wn_146_startup.png]] [[improved]] Volume ramp speed. A sensitivity slider for how fast the volume moves while you hold a volume button (Xbox and wheel). [[img:asset:wn_146_volume.png]] [[improved]] Tap and hold, either way. Bind track-change and volume to tap or hold in whichever combination you like. Both directions work now. [[improved]] Menu music. The music now stays quiet through the whole garage, map and pause, and comes back only once you actually drive off. Pressing the gas no longer pops it back early. [[sub:Smaller fixes]] [[fix]] Menu volume. The D-pad no longer nudges the volume while you navigate a menu. [[fix]] Per-app volume. Works on non-default audio devices and Microsoft Store apps now. [[fix]] Info hover. The info tooltip no longer double-pops or changes size when the mouse moves slightly. [[fix]] Xbox Controls flash. No more white flash when opening Controls. More polish under the hood. ❤️
